answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zephyr of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cedar is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
